cse.name: Computer Science and Engineering
programs: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering
cse.about: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering was established in 1986 with an initial intake of 60 students, later increased to 120 and currently 180. The department is affiliated with Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), approved by AICTE and is committed to providing quality education, research and innovation. It offers excellent computing facilities, experienced faculty and strong industry collaborations.
cse.vision: To build competent professionals embedded with human values to meet the challenges in the field of Computer Science and Engineering.
mission: Empower graduates with strong fundamentals in design and implementation of computational systems through curriculum and research.
Provide state-of-the-art infrastructure and professionally committed faculty.
Develop ethical values, technical capabilities and leadership qualities.
facilities: Center of Excellence in AI & ML

ise.name: Information Science and Engineering
programs: B.E. in Information Science and Engineering
ise.about: The Department of Information Science and Engineering focuses on software development, database systems, networking, cloud computing, cybersecurity and emerging technologies. The department prepares students with strong technical knowledge, practical skills and industry-oriented learning.
ise.vision: To produce competent Information Science professionals with ethical values and technical excellence.
mission: Provide quality education in Information Science and Engineering.
Encourage innovation, research and lifelong learning.
Develop leadership, teamwork and professional ethics.

aiml.name: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
programs: B.E. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
aiml.about: The Department of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning focuses on building intelligent systems using AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Data Science, Computer Vision and Natural Language Processing. The department provides students with strong theoretical knowledge, practical skills and industry-oriented learning to solve real-world problems.
aiml.vision: To develop competent Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning professionals with technical excellence, innovation and ethical values.
mission: Provide quality education in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
Promote research, innovation and interdisciplinary learning.
Develop industry-ready professionals with problem-solving and leadership skills.

ece.name: Electronics and Communication Engineering
programs: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
M.Tech. in VLSI Design and Embedded Systems
Ph.D. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
ece.about: The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering was established in 1986. The department provides quality education in electronics, communication systems, embedded systems, VLSI, IoT and signal processing through modern laboratories, experienced faculty and industry-oriented learning.
ece.vision: To produce competent Electronics and Communication Engineers with technical excellence, innovation and ethical values.
mission: Provide quality education in Electronics and Communication Engineering.
Promote research, innovation and industry collaboration.
Develop professional ethics, leadership and lifelong learning skills.

mechanical.name: Mechanical Engineering
mechanical.about: The Department of Mechanical Engineering was established in 1986. The department provides quality education in design, manufacturing, thermal engineering, automation, robotics and industrial engineering. It offers modern laboratories, experienced faculty and industry-oriented learning to prepare students for careers in core industries and advanced technologies.
mechanical.vision: To produce competent Mechanical Engineers with technical excellence, innovation, leadership and ethical values.
mission: Provide quality education in Mechanical Engineering through effective teaching and practical learning.
Promote research, innovation and collaboration with industries.
Develop professional ethics, leadership qualities and lifelong learning among students.

civil.name: Civil Engineering
civil.about: The Department of Civil Engineering was established in 1986. The department provides quality education in structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, transportation engineering, environmental engineering and water resources. Students gain practical knowledge through well-equipped laboratories, field visits and industry-oriented projects.
civil.vision: To develop competent Civil Engineers with technical excellence, innovation, environmental awareness and professional ethics.
mission: Provide quality education in Civil Engineering through effective teaching and practical learning.
Promote research, innovation and sustainable engineering practices.
Develop professional ethics, leadership qualities and lifelong learning among students.

aeronautical.name: Aeronautical Engineering
aeronautical.about: The Department of Aeronautical Engineering offers quality education in aircraft design, aerodynamics, propulsion systems, aircraft structures and maintenance. The department emphasizes practical learning through laboratories, projects and industry exposure.
aeronautical.vision: To develop competent Aeronautical Engineers capable of contributing to the aviation and aerospace industries with innovation and ethical values.
mission: Provide quality education in Aeronautical Engineering.
Promote research and innovation in aviation technologies.
Develop technically skilled professionals with leadership qualities.

mba.name: Master of Business Administration
mba.about: The Department of Management Studies provides quality education in business administration with specialization in Finance, Marketing, Human Resource Management and Business Analytics. The department prepares students for leadership roles through industry interaction and practical learning.
mba.vision: To develop competent management professionals with leadership, innovation and ethical values.
mission: Provide quality management education.
Promote entrepreneurship and innovation.
Develop ethical leaders capable of solving business challenges.
